identity.fantasy: A shadow marksman who hunts beside a growing pack of hounds and crows, using ranged shots to direct and amplify the swarm.
identity.one_line: A Shadowhound commander focused on sustained single-target damage. Unleash the Hounds and Houndmaster's Call establish the pet package, Shadowblast and Sixfold Shot drive the priority loop, and traps and brands add utility. A July deep dive describes smooth boss damage, good personal durability, average AoE, and at least one pet talent that was still bugged at the time.

mechanics.core_loop: Keep Unleash the Hounds and Houndmaster's Call working, build Shadowblast pressure, then use proc-gated Quickdraw and the level-50 Sixfold Shot conversion while Darkflock covers multi-target situations.

modes.name: Sixfold Shot
modes.structural_description: Level 50 PassiveEvery 5th Darkslayer within 15 seconds now transforms your Quickdraw into Sixfold Shot.Sixfold ShotUnleash 6 quick shots across 1.5 seconds, each dealing 100% Ranged Weapon Damage plus 133 Physical damage and generating 3 Rage. and 2% maximum mana.Usable while moving.

mechanics.single_target: Current guide priority places Unleash the Hounds and Houndmaster's Call first, then Shadowblast to five stacks, followed by Sixfold Shot and Quickdraw.
mechanics.aoe: Darkflock supplies cone pressure and Feast of Talons rewards connecting with at least five enemies; community guidance still describes overall AoE as average.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Pets keep contributing while the player repositions, but hound leap commands and stacked target effects reward deliberate focus.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Pet pressure and Witch Hunter movement tools make leveling feel protected; current players describe the spec as durable, with mana as a more common concern.
mechanics.group_utility: The broader Witch Hunter kit contributes ranged control and movement, while the specialization focuses primarily on damage and pet pressure.

enjoy_if.text: You want a relatively approachable ranged spec whose pets carry meaningful damage and protection.

You enjoy the spec's core cadence: keep unleash the hounds and houndmaster's call working, build shadowblast pressure, then use proc-gated quickdraw and the level-50 sixfold shot conversion while darkflock covers multi-target situations.

avoid_if.text: You want high-control pet micromanagement or exceptional pack damage.
You dislike the positioning or swap constraint that pets keep contributing while the player repositions, but hound leap commands and stacked target effects reward deliberate focus.

praise.theme: Recent players describe Houndmaster as simple, durable, and pet-protected, with strong single-target damage.

frustrations.theme: Mana pressure, average AoE, an underwhelming Quickdraw, and a reported Lethal Pursuit bug are current cautions.
